title: Dark Brotherhood
description: The guild of assassins serving Sithis and the Night Mother, or its destruction.

items.title: Innocence Lost
items.description: In Windhelm, a boy named Aventus Aretino is performing the Black Sacrament. Kill Grelod the Kind, the matron of Honorhall Orphanage in Riften.
tips: Guards and townsfolk in Windhelm gossip about the boy; you can also start the quest just by entering his house.

items.title: With Friends Like These…
items.description: You are abducted and taken to the Abandoned Shack. Astrid demands you kill one of three bound captives to prove your loyalty.
tips: After you complete Innocence Lost, a courier brings a note reading "We Know" once you sleep.
items.missable: The choice is final: killing Astrid closes the Dark Brotherhood questline for good.

choices.question: Join the Brotherhood or destroy it?

options.label: Kill a captive and join
options.result: You become a member of the Dark Brotherhood and gain access to the Falkreath Sanctuary.

options.label: Kill Astrid
options.result: Starts Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!: the Penitus Oculatus help you wipe out the Sanctuary. The whole Brotherhood questline becomes unavailable.

items.title: Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!
items.description: After killing Astrid, report to a guard, then to Commander Maro of the Penitus Oculatus. Infiltrate the Sanctuary and kill everyone inside.
tips: You learn the password for the Sanctuary's Black Door during the quest.

items.title: Sanctuary
items.description: Enter the Sanctuary through the Black Door (the answer is "Silence, my brother"), meet the Family and get your first contracts.
tips: Later in the questline Astrid gives you the immortal horse Shadowmere.

items.title: Mourning Never Comes
items.description: Meet the client Muiri in Markarth and fulfill her contract on Alain Dufont.
tips: Muiri pays extra for killing Nilsine Shatter-Shield in Windhelm.

items.title: Whispers in the Dark
items.description: The jester Cicero has brought the Night Mother's coffin to the Sanctuary. The Night Mother speaks to you: you are now the Listener.
tips: Astrid is wary: hear her out before you act.

items.title: The Silence Has Been Broken
items.description: Meet Amaund Motierre in Volunruud. He orders a hit on the Emperor; take his letter and amulet to Astrid.

items.title: Bound Until Death
items.description: Kill the Emperor's cousin, Vittoria Vici, at her wedding in Solitude.
tips: Bonus: kill her during her wedding speech on the balcony.

items.title: Breaching Security
items.description: Kill Gaius Maro, son of the Penitus Oculatus commander, and plant a forged letter about a conspiracy on him.
tips: Gaius Maro's Schedule tells you the best spots to intercept him.

items.title: The Cure for Madness
items.description: Cicero has betrayed the Family and fled. Hunt him down in the Dawnstar Sanctuary.
items.missable: Spare Cicero and you can recruit him as a follower later; kill him and that option is gone for good.

choices.question: Kill Cicero or let him go?

options.label: Kill him
options.result: Cicero dies; you can take his jester's outfit.

options.label: Let him go
options.result: Cicero escapes; after the questline ends he shows up at the Dawnstar Sanctuary and becomes available as a follower.

items.title: Recipe for Disaster
items.description: Find out who is hiding behind the famous chef known as the Gourmet, eliminate him and take his Writ of Passage. It gets you into the Emperor's kitchen.

items.title: To Kill an Empire
items.description: Posing as the Gourmet, slip into the Castle Dour kitchen and kill the Emperor at the feast. The "Emperor" turns out to be a decoy, and the Penitus Oculatus have set a trap for you.
items.missable: After this quest the Falkreath Sanctuary is destroyed and most of the Family dies.

items.title: Death Incarnate
items.description: The Penitus Oculatus storm the Falkreath Sanctuary. Fight your way in, save the survivors (Nazir and Babette), escape and deal with Astrid, who betrayed you.
items.missable: Astrid's Blade of Woe can only be taken now; it is an optional objective of the quest.

items.title: Hail Sithis!
items.description: Board the ship Katariah and kill Emperor Titus Mede II.
items.missable: The Emperor dies. This permanently changes the game world and closes dialogue tied to him.

items.title: Take the Hidden Treasure
items.description: Buy the torture room upgrade for the Dawnstar Sanctuary from Delvin Mallory. The four prisoners each reveal where they hid their gold — 1,000–2,000 septims apiece.

items.title: Delayed Burial
items.description: Cicero is stuck near Loreius Farm with a broken cart carrying a coffin. You can persuade Vantus Loreius to fix the wheel or report the jester to a guard.
tips: The quest fails if you enter the Brotherhood Sanctuary or start Destroy the Dark Brotherhood!, so deal with it first.

items.title: Locate the Assassin of Old
items.description: Olava the Feeble reads Olava's Token, Gabriella's bonus for Breaching Security. The trail leads through Deepwood Redoubt to Hag's End, where a Dark Brotherhood assassin lies behind a hidden wall. Reward: Ancient Shrouded Armor.

items.title: Where You Hang Your Enemy's Head
items.description: Restore and refurnish the Dawnstar Sanctuary after Hail Sithis!. Delvin Mallory in Riften helps with supplies.

items.title: The Dark Brotherhood Forever
items.description: Repeatable Dark Brotherhood Forever contracts: the Night Mother passes kill orders on people all over Skyrim through the Listener.

items.title: Kill Narfi
items.description: Kill Narfi, a wretched beggar.
tips: Required to advance the Brotherhood questline.

items.title: Kill Beitild
items.description: Settle a feud between former spouses: the contract is on Beitild.
tips: Required to advance the Brotherhood questline.

items.title: Kill Ennodius Papius
items.description: Eliminate Ennodius Papius, the mill's former owner.
tips: Required to advance the Brotherhood questline.

items.title: Kill Hern
items.description: Kill Hern, a reclusive vampire.
tips: To advance, you need one of the two contracts: Hern or Lurbuk.

items.title: Kill Lurbuk
items.description: Silence Skyrim's worst bard for good.
tips: To advance, you need one of the two contracts: Hern or Lurbuk.

items.title: Kill Deekus
items.location: A shipwreck on the northern coast
items.description: Kill an Argonian looting wrecked ships.

items.title: Kill Ma'randru-jo
items.description: Kill an arrogant Khajiit mage from Ri'saad's caravan.

items.title: Kill Anoriath
items.description: Kill a talkative Bosmer hunter.

items.title: Kill Agnis
items.description: Kill the fort's grumpy maid.

items.title: Kill Maluril
items.description: Kill a fugitive mage who leads a gang of bandits.

items.title: Kill Helvard
items.description: Kill Jarl Siddgeir's arrogant housecarl.

items.title: Kill Safia
items.location: The Red Wave, by the East Empire Company Warehouse, Solitude
items.description: Kill the pirate captain Safia aboard her own ship.
